focus.title: 欧盟修订《反胁迫工具法案》实施细则，新增反制清单触发条件
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于2026年6月24日发布《反胁迫工具法案》（ACI）实施细则，明确当第三国采取“经济胁迫”措施（如限制贸易、投资或技术转让）时，欧盟可对其实施反制措施，包括加征关税、暂停知识产权保护或限制服务贸易。新规将“胁迫”定义扩展至数字服务与数据流动限制，并建立快速响应机制。中国出海企业需关注欧盟对华贸易政策风险，尤其是新能源、半导体及跨境电商领域。
focus.title_en: EU Revises Enforcement Rules for Anti-Coercion Instrument, Adds New Trigger Conditions for Countermeasures
focus.summary_en: On June 24, 2026, the European Commission published implementing rules for the Anti-Coercion Instrument (ACI), specifying that when a third country takes 'economic coercion' measures (e.g., restricting trade, investment, or technology transfer), the EU may impose countermeasures including tariffs, suspension of IP protection, or restrictions on service trade. The new rules expand the definition of coercion to cover digital services and data flow restrictions and establish a rapid response mechanism. Chinese overseas-bound enterprises should monitor EU trade policy risks, especially in new energy, semiconductors, and cross-border e-commerce.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁庭裁决：中国承包商因不可抗力条款约定不明致索赔失败
case.summary: 在SIAC仲裁案（SIAC Case No. 2025-089）中，一家中国建筑企业因某东南亚国家政府项目延期，援引不可抗力条款要求免除违约金并索赔额外费用。仲裁庭认定，合同中的不可抗力条款未明确列举疫情、供应链中断等情形，且企业未及时履行通知义务，故驳回其主张。该案提示中国企业：涉外合同中的不可抗力条款应具体化，并严格遵循程序性要求。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）2026年6月裁决
case.title_en: SIAC Rules Against Chinese Contractor for Vague Force Majeure Clause in Dispute over Government Project Delay
case.summary_en: In SIAC Case No. 2025-089, a Chinese construction firm invoked a force majeure clause to seek exemption from liquidated damages and additional costs for a delay in a Southeast Asian government project. The tribunal held that the clause did not explicitly cover pandemics or supply chain disruptions, and the contractor failed to give timely notice, thus rejecting the claim. This case highlights that force majeure clauses in cross-border contracts should be specific, and procedural requirements must be strictly followed.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) Award, June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区发布《跨境数据流动安全评估指引（2026版）》，简化合规流程
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室联合香港、澳门相关部门于2026年6月20日发布新版指引，对粤港澳大湾区内的跨境数据流动实行“白名单”管理。对列入白名单的常见商业数据（如物流、支付、供应链信息）免予安全评估，仅需备案；对敏感个人信息和重要数据仍保留评估要求。该指引旨在促进大湾区数字贸易便利化，企业可据此优化数据出境合规方案。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.06.26
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Issues 2026 Guidelines on Cross-Border Data Flow Security Assessment, Streamlining Compliance
policy.summary_en: On June 20, 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong, together with Hong Kong and Macao authorities, released new guidelines adopting a 'whitelist' approach for cross-border data flows within the Greater Bay Area. Common business data (e.g., logistics, payment, supply chain information) on the whitelist are exempt from security assessment and require only filing; assessment remains for sensitive personal information and important data. The guidelines aim to facilitate digital trade in the region, and enterprises can optimize their data export compliance strategies accordingly.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.06.26

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：中国企业应警惕美国对华半导体设备出口管制“长臂管辖”新动向
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）近期拟修订《出口管理条例》（EAR），将“外国直接产品规则”扩展至更多半导体制造设备，并加强对“最终用户”的审查。建议中国半导体企业：（1）全面审查供应链中美国原产技术占比；（2）对涉及美国技术的高风险交易申请许可证；（3）建立内部合规体系，区分EAR与非EAR技术。同时关注中国反制措施的动态，如不可靠实体清单。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Chinese Companies Should Watch New Developments in US 'Long-Arm Jurisdiction' over Semiconductor Equipment Export Controls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is proposing to amend the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) to extend the 'foreign direct product rule' to more semiconductor manufacturing equipment and tighten end-user screening. Chinese semiconductor companies are advised to: (1) comprehensively review the proportion of US-origin technology in their supply chains; (2) apply for licenses for high-risk transactions involving US technology; (3) establish internal compliance systems to distinguish EAR from non-EAR technologies. Also monitor China's countermeasures, such as the Unreliable Entity List.
